updates.source: Official public notice from the National Aviation Testing Lab
updates.text: The National Aviation Testing Lab issued a formal retraction stating that AeroGlide X1 never achieved the recorded wind resistance speed during flight testing.

policies.text: An aircraft achieves safety baseline clearance if its sustained air resistance velocity equals at least 50 km/h and it possesses active CE Mark safety certification.
A model is permitted for municipal overflight if it has commercial drone qualification alongside a parachute deployment system response time of no more than 1.0 seconds.
A drone is designated for urgent relief dispatch when it receives elevated hazard authorization and logs a minimum of 100 autonomous night flight hours this year.
A commercial drone qualification is granted when an aircraft achieves safety baseline clearance.
An inverter achieves premium grid interconnection eligibility if its peak efficiency rating is equal to or greater than 97.0 percent.
An aerial vehicle receives elevated hazard authorization provided it is permitted for municipal overflight and maintains annual operational insurance coverage of at least 2,000,000 USD.
A commercial storage unit achieves utility-scale endorsement provided its thermal management threshold remains under 45 degrees Celsius.
A maritime vessel receives deep-water navigation endorsement if its hull integrity rating exceeds 90 points and it maintains active satellite tracking.
